answer: Each agent must lock an anchor bond proportional to its computational delta, recorded on a trellis of inter‑agent attestations. Periodically peers challenge newcomers by broadcasting a random nonce; the challenged agent must produce a zero‑knowledge proof that its bond originated from a unique previous attestation, otherwise the bond is slashed. An attacker must acquire enough distinct anchor bonds to survive each slash, making the cost grow linearly with the number of Sybil identities they wish to sustain.
